title: Private deployment (Acme) - weekly sync notes 2026-04-13
content:
Meeting: Acme private deployment - weekly sync (prep + notes)
Date: 2026-04-13
Attendees (confirmed): Jordan Lee (Acme), Ava Martinez (Redwood), Riley Park (Redwood), Sofia Gupta (Redwood), Evan Clarke (Redwood)

Purpose: 30-min weekly customer sync to track VPC/on-prem milestones, surface blockers, align owners and next steps. This is my prep + notes skeleton to use during the call and follow up.

AGENDA (30m)
1) Quick status (3m) - Ava
   - Current milestone: "Network validation complete" (customer reported partial)
   - Last week: VPN handshake attempted; packet loss observed during routing tests

2) Blockers & risks (10m) - Jordan + tech leads
   - Customer firewall blocking control-plane egress (ports 443 + 8443) - Jordan to confirm exact rule set
   - Certificate rotation plan needed for on-prem control-plane (SLA for cert replacement) - action item below
   - Storage perf regression on node group B during long-run tests - Evan investigating

3) Milestone review & timeline (7m)
   - Milestone A: Network & VPN validation - target 2026-04-15
   - Milestone B: Private control-plane deploy to staging - target 2026-04-22
   - Milestone C: Cutover window / performance validation - target 2026-05-06
   - Ask: customer capacity for a 90-min performance run week of 2026-04-27

4) Ops & support (5m)
   - Escalation path (SRE on-call) and runbook share - Riley to drive
   - Logging/metrics retention and audit setup (customer asked about 90-day retention)

5) Next steps & action review (5m)

PREP NOTES / KEY POINTS TO MENTION
- Reiterate our fallback plan: if VPN remains flaky, propose temporary dedicated tunnel (site-to-site) + redirect control-plane to hosted endpoint for management plane only. Clarify cost/ops tradeoffs.
- Bring up cert rotation schedule: propose automated ACME-like rotation vs. manual with 7-day renew buffer.
- Performance regression: value of running extended load test in staging (we need customer sign-off on time + data to replicate storage workload).
- Confirm time zone preferences for cutover (Jordan prefers PDT mornings).

BLOCKERS (detailed)
- Firewall rules: customer reports "apparently allowed" but our tests show resets. Need: exact ACL export from customer FW (ASA/Fortigate) + timestamped tcpdump from their edge. Owner: Jordan (Acme) - due 2026-04-14.
- Certificate expiration: current cert on control-plane expires 2026-04-20. If rotation plan not in place, risk of outage during staging deploy. Owner: Ava (draft rotation plan) + Jordan (confirm preferred tooling) - draft by 2026-04-14, final plan by 2026-04-16.
- Storage node perf: Node group B shows 20% lower IOPS under sustained load vs. baseline. Evan to reproduce, collect iostat and kernel logs. Owner: Evan Clarke - initial triage by 2026-04-15.

ACTION ITEMS (for follow-up; will paste into Jira as tasks)
- ACME-Action-001: Customer to export and share FW ACL + tcpdump snippet (Jordan Lee) - due 2026-04-14.
- ACME-Action-002: Draft cert rotation playbook (Ava Martinez) - due 2026-04-14. Include rollback steps and required IAM/KMS roles.
- ACME-Action-003: Run extended storage load test in staging; capture perf profile and artifacts (Evan Clarke + Sofia Gupta) - schedule run and confirm window by 2026-04-15; run by 2026-04-17.
- ACME-Action-004: Share SRE on-call and escalation runbook with customer; include paging policy (Riley Park) - due 2026-04-16.
- ACME-Action-005: Propose temporary dedicated tunnel + cost estimate if VPN remains unstable (Ava Martinez + Solutions Eng) - due 2026-04-15.

NOTES TO SELF (informal)
- Keep language customer-friendly; avoid deep infra jargon in exec summary.
- During call: ask Jordan whether they can do a packet capture during next attempted handshake - gives deterministic evidence.
- Remind SRE: enable extra debug logs for control-plane during staging deploy (will increase noise; capture window).

POSSIBLE RISKS / MITIGATIONS
- Risk: Cert lapse during staging deploy -> Mitigation: temporary allowlist of management IPs and manual renewal plan (if automation fails).
- Risk: Storage perf shows variance only in prod-like dataset -> Mitigation: synthesize customer dataset subset and run on staging; if not possible, set broader cutover window with fallbacks.

FOLLOW-UP (email / Jira to send after meeting)
- Summary email with decisions + pasted action items (assign Jira keys).
- Attach: latest network diag, packet capture instructions, cert rotation draft.
- Ask customer for preferred time for 90-min perf run week of 2026-04-27 (options: 2026-04-28 09:00 PDT or 2026-04-29 08:00 PDT).

QUICK LINKS / REFERENCES
- Confluence: /confluence/acme-private-deploy (internal)
- Jira: ACME-1234 (master epic)
- Slack: #acme-private-deploy (channel)
- Internal runbook: /confluence/runbooks/private-deployments-control-plane

---
Triage checklist (post-meeting):
- Convert action items to Jira tickets and tag with epic ACME-1234.
- Update milestone dates in shared timeline doc.
- Schedule deep-dive with storage infra if Evan confirms hardware vs. config.

Notes end.

(Will update after 4/13 call with live notes and final action owners / Jira numbers)
